title: Jev as a second opinion for novelty in Daily AI Signals
depends_on: PR #39 (006-daily-ai-signals) merged and running in production
Phase 7 validation numbers recorded in specs/006-daily-ai-signals/dry-run.md
problem: New is decided by one DeepSeek flash call per article (entity-level is_new + exact quote) plus deterministic checks. After code fixes the displayed precision is 85% with 6 of 40 items in a grey zone (features of existing products, internal tools, startup profiles, reviews) and some BAD items hidden below the display cap. Prompt revisions did not move precision without losing recall.
idea: Ask Jev, the cheap probability-returning classifier already used for admission, relevance and topic, a separate novelty question per article (optionally per candidate entity). Show an entity as New only when DeepSeek marks it new with a quote AND Jev confirms the article announces a new release with confidence above a threshold. Two different models must both be wrong for a false New.

facts.jev_client: src/app/core/jev.py (JevRelevanceScorer): body {model, state, questions}; question types 'choice' and 'noul'; answers carry a choice and a probability/confidence
facts.price_assumption: Jev ~0.042 USD per million input tokens, output free (rates in daily-digest log); ~7-30x cheaper than DeepSeek per article
facts.known_limit: Jev holds long inputs (log message jev_input_held, reason conservative_input_bound)
facts.current_use: Jev runs at fetch time for admission (~150 calls/day, ~0.02 USD/day); daily signals do not call Jev

draft_question.name: novelty

criteria.new_release_now: The article announces, in this news, the launch, release, public availability, founding or stealth exit of a specific AI model, product, company, chip or named technique/benchmark/dataset.
criteria.update_or_feature: An existing product or model gets an update, a new feature, setting, plan, integration, port or price change.
criteria.retrospective_or_review: The article reviews, recounts or tests something released earlier, including year-in-review lists and hands-on reviews.
criteria.internal_or_case_study: A tool built by a company for its own use, or a customer case study.
criteria.not_a_release: Research findings, opinion, business or policy news without a release.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Cannot decide from the supplied text.

draft_question.notes: Separate rubric version from the admission rubric; never modify the pinned admission questions. Optional per-entity variant: include the candidate entity name in the instructions and ask whether that entity itself is newly released.

tasks.title: Offline experiment on the five gate days
steps: Throwaway script in tmp/: run the novelty question for the 369 in-scope articles of 2026-10-12..16 (cents).
Join with the labelled New items from prompt-gate.md (displayed and hidden, OK/BAD/uncertain verdicts) and the recall list.
For thresholds 0.5..0.9 report: precision of displayed New, precision of uncapped New, recall, which grey-zone items are removed and which OK items are lost.
Also test the per-entity variant on the New candidates only.
tasks.done_when: A short results table in a docs file and a recommendation: adopt (with threshold) or drop.

tasks.title: Decide the gating rule
options: AND gate: New requires DeepSeek is_new+quote and Jev new_release_now >= threshold.
Demotion: Jev below threshold moves the item to 'early signal' or below the display cap instead of removing it.
Tie-breaker only: Jev consulted for early (single-publisher) items, confirmed items unchanged.
tasks.criteria: Choose by J1 numbers; precision gain must not cost more than a few points of recall.

tasks.title: Implement in the signals pipeline
steps: Store the Jev answer per article and rubric version next to article_signals (cached, versioned, re-computable), not in the admission tables.
Call Jev only for articles that have at least one is_new candidate, to keep calls minimal.
Spending and call caps via the existing per-run caps; Jev unavailable, held input or invalid answer => behave exactly as today (DeepSeek-only decision) and record the reason.
Apply the gating rule in daily_signals_compute.py as a pure function; thresholds as constants recorded in the snapshot (OD7) with a methodology version bump.
Backfill Jev answers for history with the recompute flow; no DeepSeek re-extraction needed.
tests: Gate on/off, threshold boundaries, Jev missing/held/invalid fallback, cache reuse, no Jev call when there is no novelty candidate, snapshot hash changes only with the methodology version.

tasks.title: Validate and roll out
steps: Re-measure the five days and the Phase 7 history with the gate (displayed and uncapped precision, recall).
Feature flag default off; owner enables after review.
Document in docs/daily-signals.md and the plan.

risks: Article-level answer cannot say which entity is new; per-entity variant costs more calls.
Long articles held by Jev input bounds fall back to DeepSeek-only.
Another provider dependency in the daily job; must fail open to current behaviour.
Over-filtering may hide real launches; J1 must measure recall, not only precision.
out_of_scope: Changing the admission rubric or its pinned version.
